page.overview:
Who is Bannerjee?

Bannerjee was a Security Officer of Emperor Paul Atreides. He was one of who came up through the Fremen Constabulary, winning his place on brains and proven loyalty despite the smuggler ancestry attested by his name. Both Chani and Stilgar trusted him. Abumojandis served as his aide.

Bannerjee was a solid figure, almost fat. Wisps of black hair fell down over the dark, wet-appearing skin of his forehead like the crest of an exotic bird. His eyes were blue-blue and steady in a gaze which could look upon happiness or atrocity without change of expression.

In a deleted scene from Dune Messiah, Abumojandis is present with Abumojandis and Paul Atreides using a distrans recorder to extract the names of the conspirators from Bijaz. Upon being named as a traitor, Abumojandis attempts to assassinate Paul with a cutterray, but Bannerjee sacrifices himself stepping in the way of his cutterray while Paul himself hurls a knife, killing his aide. Bannerjee is grievously injured, but survives the attack.
